title: Flipping an Image
description:
You are given a square binary matrix image of size n × n.

Do the following for each row:

Reverse the row (flip horizontally)
Invert all values:
0 → 1
1 → 0

Return the final matrix.

Examples

Example 1

Input:
[[1,1,0],[1,0,1],[0,0,0]]

Output:
[[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[1,1,1]]

Example 2

Input:
[[1,1,0,0],[1,0,0,1],[0,1,1,1],[1,0,1,0]]

Output:
[[1,1,0,0],[0,1,1,0],[0,0,0,1],[1,0,1,0]]
Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 20
image[i][j] is either 0 or 1
Matrix is always square
input_format: Read from standard input. Format details depends on the problem.
